theorems.name: Submission.constancy_mollified_density_const
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl n)) (u : (Eucl n → ℝ) → ℝ), (∀ a : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ U → ∀ j : Fin n, u (fun x => fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) = 0) → ∀ (x₀ : Eucl n) (ρ ε : ℝ), 0 < ρ → 0 < ε → closedBall x₀ (ρ + ε) ⊆ U → ∀ φ : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ closedBall 0 ε → ∀ θ : Eucl n → ℝ, Measurable θ → (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x, |θ x| ≤ M) → (∀ f : Eucl n → ℝ, IntegrableOn f (ball x₀ ρ) volume → u (convolution φ ((ball x₀ ρ).indicator f) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) = ∫ x in ball x₀ ρ, f x * θ x ∂volume) → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ f : Eucl n → ℝ, IntegrableOn f (ball x₀ ρ) volume → u (convolution φ ((ball x₀ ρ).indicator f) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) = c * ∫ x in ball x₀ ρ, f x ∂volume
